# Proverbs 19 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 19:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | [The]-folly-of a-man twists his-way, and-against YHWH his-heart rages. |
| LOGOS | When a man's folly brings his way to ruin, his heart rages against the LORD. |
| PNEUMA | People wreck their own lives through foolishness and then blame the LORD for it. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | Many entreat [the]-face-of a-noble, and-everyone [is] a-friend to-a-man-of gifts. |
| LOGOS | Many seek the favor of a generous man, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts. |
| PNEUMA | Everybody wants to get close to a generous person, and everyone claims to be friends with the gift-giver. |

## 19:11 (overlap: 0%)

| EMET | [The]-discretion-of a-man makes-slow his-anger, and-his-glory [is] to-pass-over a-transgression. |

| PNEUMA | Wisdom gives you the ability to control your anger, and your greatest glory comes from letting an offense go. |
